units.followup: numbered ambient encounter (script selfRegistered, noCombat) + codex page on Reach pack culture; hot-lanes readout generated from the seeded encounter tables themselves — one source of truth, never a parallel hand-authored schedule (honed)

units.title: The Reader's Stake Bookmark
units.followup: real gate: quill_copied counter flag >= 2 (src/data/quill.js copiedFlag) + player in sector; ribbon dressing at poi_charon_reader_stake; Archive standing +4; codex page "The Recommendations."

units.title: The Two-Credit Truth
units.followup: three-losses-in-a-row sale counter at the Belt Outpost scale keys the barContacts dialogue; flag two_credit_truth; the next above-band sale yields +2% one-time; codex page "Two-Credit Truth."

units.title: The Bargain Light
units.followup: lamp prop channel on the Den's vent spine, Ring-Fair-only; the blink pattern is authored data and decodes (codex) to a real map hint

units.title: The Lost Freight's Address
units.followup: cross-reference gate: poi_helios_lost_freight scanned, then any Helios dock's lost-property board shows the tag; carrying the tag (a mail attachment) to the freight ships both halves — flag + codex page "The Waiting Problem."

units.title: The Previous Tenant's Mail
units.followup: fires once, on the second hull onward; mail.js cast row + the letter's author becomes a bar regular via the canonical barContacts contact pattern

units.title: The Third Stool's Letter
units.followup: same-station dock counter (10+) at Quinn's bar; bar greeting changes permanently ("Your stool. Same one."); +1 bar-contact mission payouts at that station for the rest of the game

units.title: The Dog Watch Knot
units.followup: dog-watch phase check + radial-sequence solve interaction (commsRadial offer pattern, src/ui/commsRadial.js); flag knot_undone pays free drinks at Coalition bars permanently and Concord rep +2 ("patience under watch")

units.title: The Paper Plane
units.followup: ballistic prop on a computed arc + one explosionBreach cue light at burnout, all pooled; witness-gated codex entry (two lines: "who folds these?")

units.title: The Hum at Sker
units.followup: stillness gate (thrust under 5% inside the 80 WU zone for 30 s) ducks all other audio and unmutes a chord mix of existing ambient recipes — pure audio-bus work; codex entry: a listening place in the loudest sector

units.title: The Split Station's Third Half
units.followup: three-scan sequence on poi_tethys_split_station via discoveryPresentation.js (halves, then the gap) keyed in story.flags; the invisible third section as scan copy + hidden mass reading; codex page "The Third Half"; Tethys standing +2; the Split Station market gains one unlisted commodity slot (stock: mystery, rotates)

units.title: The Broken Shepherd's Flock
units.followup: kill-event proximity check (600 WU of poi_charon_broken_shepherd) + wreck-herding presentation on the uniqueWrecks seam orbiting the fresh wreckage; flag flock_reflocked; the wreckage stays collectible salvage for anyone (Understory first claim); codex page "Re-Flocked"

units.title: The Still Eye
units.followup: sectorZones zone record (anomaly_deep type, no presence) whose position steps one band-width per season from a season hash; drag/heat exemption keyed by the same predicate as the planets.js storm bands; codex entry; tracking it across seasons is the pilot skill

units.title: The Slurry Relic's Contents
units.followup: commodity-context scan branch (fires after sampling any slurry cargo) on the poi_charon_slurry scan copy; flag panel9_found; codex page "Panel Nine"; the wrong-grid reveal gains a physical middle chapter via the Bay 7 thread flags

units.title: The Hum
units.followup: numbered anomaly encounter on a fixed seeded deep wreck with the requiredPings pattern (140-unique-wreck-deepsurvey-ping-elite.js precedent); one new whisper line readable only here added to WHISPER_LINES; codex entry reframing every prior whisper as fleet-wide

units.title: The Quiet Mast's Silence Toll
units.followup: chatter-rate check (three hails within 60 s inside the poi_io_quiet_mast radius) gating the edited-hail playback variant; register payoff per hone: hails resolve on the first ping + a band-priority greeting other pilots notice (bark variant); flag mast_prefers_you; codex page "The Mast Prefers You"

units.title: The Ash Pin's Second Age
units.followup: two-visit flag (both poi_helios_ash_pin and poi_ceres_ash_pin discovered within one in-game week) + combined codex overlay "The Two Pins"; the missing middle line is the player's own campaign thread number; flag pins_paired

units.title: The Echo Bank
units.followup: numbered anomaly encounter persisting the last 5 comms:popup payloads (bounded ring buffer in story.flags, per hone — no full history store); one replay of the player's own past line per visit window via comms:popup with lag; codex entry on who built a memory bank and why they needed receipts

units.title: The Prism Read
units.followup: numbered ambient encounter reading real power/fit state via the ship-stats seam; spectrum-fan vfx through the light-behavior path; honest one-per-visit readings as barks derived from the player's actual systems

units.title: The Nereid Coupling Riddle
units.followup: dock-attempt interaction + dialog state on the empty mid-dock coupling; answer branch (any verdict accepted); codex page "Still Out"; Nereid standing +2; the handshake thereafter completes for the player in four steps instead of nine ("it remembers the shape")

units.title: The Metal Garden
units.followup: numbered anomaly encounter with magnetic attraction forces (bolusForces precedent); pulled salvage dragged back within a day unless the player leaves metal of their own (mass-balance persistence in story.flags — the garden keeps its mass); offerings visibly add to the fringe

units.title: The Three Hull Garden's Fourth
units.followup: wreck-within-tether-radius persistence (24+ in-game hours) on poi_charon_hull_garden + garden stage reuse for the fourth planter; flag garden_fourth_planted; weekly visits advance the engraving; a completed plaque = the garden stages up

units.title: The Vigil Array's Request
units.followup: worldCalendar night-window gate on the poi_io_cathedral_vigil proximity + watch interaction (four hours sim, duty-cycle compressed); flag vigil_named; wall dressing gains the player callsign permanently; Io standing +4; one-time +5% night-sensor efficiency ("the night knows you now")

units.title: The Star Marker's Star
units.followup: scan copy per shift phase (two worldCalendar phases) on poi_charon_star_marker; intersection POI spawned on flag star_marker_fixed revealing a single preserved cockpit beacon — a grave; codex page; Understory rep +3 if the player leaves it undisturbed (never scans it a third time)

units.title: The Vanishing Field
units.followup: seeded per-visit count ledger (the discovery-bag pattern: state.world.discovery[sectorId]) shrinking the field each visit; the missing rocks placed in the numbered row from the same seed stream; codex entry "a mystery with an audit trail"

units.title: The Registry That Forgot to Die
units.followup: numbered ambient encounter on a starter-lane derelict relay; reading the full log writes state.story.flags['relay_stamp'], consumed by patrol_scan fine logic in encounterScripts.js as a one-time fine shield; codex entry

units.title: The Dead Star Chart
units.followup: first-scan overlay copy on the Sedna survey wreck + one new POI row placed at the circled offset (a dead precursor pin, Verge-Layer register) spawned on flag; codex page "The Surveyor's Last Map"

units.title: The Bell Tolls for You
units.followup: bespoke leg: on the player:death path, duck all audio except one bell toll spatialized to the nearest station (not the victim) and hold the final frame a half-beat; closure, never a penalty read.

units.title: The Bloom Tide
units.followup: bespoke leg: scheduled story-prop light curtain keyed to the bloom tide calendar read plus one cache whose surface phosphors are visible only inside the window; no edits to dirty lookMoods/vfx files.

units.title: Ember Trail
units.followup: bespoke leg: extend the ember lifetime by death tier (DEATH_MASS_TIER_THRESHOLDS) on the plunge-breakup/entity:killed handoff so the embers are the wreck marker for the salvage leg.

units.title: The Chalk
units.followup: bespoke leg: one authored starter-lane prop set with flag-gated pass tallies (no route-usage ledger exists); hazard arrows read from the player's actual collision/drift records.

units.title: The Choir's Silent Shift
units.followup: bespoke leg: calendar-window pause cue keyed to the Choir bell pulse + maintenance bell coincidence; write flag silent_shift_seen and a codex page, "The Silent Shift".

units.title: The Muster
units.followup: bespoke leg: ambient no-combat encounter spawning the drill grid at the fixed rock — cap at 12-16 drones in a bounded window (forty live hulls breaks the ambient spawn budget); scan payoff is a codex page on Reach pack logistics.

units.title: The Yard Family Reunion
units.followup: bespoke leg: provenance-stamp check on the player's hull part/cargo at the anchorage; cull-meter crowd cue + work-light turnout; write flag yard_reunion, Pitborn standing +8, and give the part's stamp a signature.

units.title: The Belt Heartbeat
units.followup: bespoke leg: audio pulse only — one low oscillator gated on simTime mod 8 inside the proximity radius; no HUD band-edge breathing (honed out); codex bio-rhythm page.

units.title: The False Gate Sparks
units.followup: bespoke leg: seasonal surge-window predicate grounds through the ring; single-rotation cue + rim pellet ignition; write flag false_gate_turned, add the plaque line with the date, and open the codex page "Once".

units.title: The Portrait Buoys
units.followup: bespoke leg: persistent buoy props with authored painted-shroud textures (no illustratedSurface edit while dirty); fame order read from deedRecord; the painter is a commission contact who prices work in stories.

units.title: Shadow Transit
units.followup: bespoke leg: sector-wide key/ambient gain envelope keyed to the transit minute through the mood-overlay seam; the spatially-walking terminator is renderer work for the graphics batch.

units.title: The Gap Light
units.followup: bespoke leg: zone-occupancy rig boost per frame through tuneLook while inside the authored gap with the key bearing inside the arc; the arc window is posted on the wire once per season.

units.title: Aurora Crown
units.followup: bespoke leg: sustained light slot in the event-light pool (vfxColorLightDirector is DIRTY — file the request, do not edit) plus a planet emissive band keyed to the ion_storm season in seasonalWeather.

units.title: The Karaoke Bell
units.followup: bespoke leg: bar audio row keyed to barPressureAt + the exact shift bell at station_forge; write flag heard_the_count_sung and Pitborn rep +1 (they heard about it and are delighted).

units.title: Hail of Ore
units.followup: bespoke leg: free-scoop emission window on the mining:yield path for the fall's duration; the light is just the returning key.

units.title: The Bedtime Bell
units.followup: bespoke leg: bar lighting/dressing keyed to the last shift of the station-day at station_helios; write flag bedtime_bell and a one-line codex page (Helios: "the bar closes in reverse order of arrival").

units.title: The Magazine
units.followup: bespoke leg: munitions-flagged hulls only; window-row emissive cook-off sequence via the lamp bus, then one delayed emitExplosionPhase rupture opening the seams.

units.title: The Cooling Cinder
units.followup: bespoke leg: capital-tier fragment only (DEATH_MASS_TIER_THRESHOLDS); emissive ramp through the black-body colors keyed to simTime since death, persisted on the wreck record.

units.title: The Scuttle
units.followup: bespoke leg: disabled-captained hulls only (seeded crew choice); lamp-bus extinguish order bow-to-stern, one comms line, then the scuttle charge opens the spine; codex entry.

units.title: The Tether Note
units.followup: bespoke leg: one oscillator keyed to massline tension telemetry; the full note requires the 95%-alignment-with-key-bearing predicate held 3 s; standing-wave shimmer on the cable surface; codex page, "the pilot's tuning fork".

units.title: The Lost Luggage Board
units.followup: Concourse dressing row keyed to roaming-story receipts (src/data/roamingStories.js): one live tag per story the player personally witnessed; the back-room describe-the-label claim game draws its inventory from encounter history (absorbs SP1-175); codex page "The Lost Property Register."

units.title: The Graft
units.followup: Authored offer at poi_charon_hull_garden + persistent hull-state prop (growth stage in story.flags): capped slow micromend on the existing armor regen path (damage.js only if clean); removable, painfully, and it remembers. The Understory florist stall is the storefront (absorbs SP2-096); "everything dead wants to be soil" moves into the care copy.

units.title: The Meteor Fishery
units.followup: weatherMeteors slot-book read + prop line on the surge path, live during meteor_shower seasons: the player may string ONE net-line, licensed for the season (40 cr and a signature); the line catches seeded stones on the public weather schedule; unlicensed lines get cut by the fishery, politely, once (capped yield flag in story.flags).

units.title: The Confessional Booth
units.followup: barContacts booth keyed to a moralMemory read (src/systems/moralMemory.js): flat tithe processes the kill record, flag guilt_filed, Choir standing +1; the read-back lands verbatim as a late mail letter on the ending screen — one Choir liturgy, two sacraments, same receipt grammar as the buoy that absolves.

units.title: The Falling Anchor
units.followup: Persistent prop with simTime drift (asteroidMotion precedent), visibly lower against the dead moon each visit; salvage tags re-price by risk as it falls; on impact day the reentry fire-line crosses the sector, everyone hears it via news:publish, and the crater persists as a landmark — the pool pays pocket change at any Ashfall bar.

units.title: The Kurtz Desk's Second Count
units.followup: Post-SP2-160 dressing at Kurtz's desk: the player's page stays open permanently — the one ledger line Kurtz will not close — flag ledger_open, Ashfall standing +6; the page's lines accrue on return visits.

units.title: The Quiet Booth
units.followup: Bar set-dressing keyed to Quiet transaction receipts (deniable:fenceThanked, then dock at station_customs within a day): flag house_drinks_to_you, one-time Quiet standing +2; the reserved plate gains the player's callsign, etched small, for the rest of the game (stationContacts persistent contact-memory line).

units.title: The Plaque
units.followup: First-kill record writes site coordinates + a persistent marker prop; returning seasons later the plate has accumulated small objects — bolts, a ribbon, someone's spare key — left by people who fly this lane (offerings accrue in story.flags, keyed to simTime since the kill).

units.title: The Two Halves
units.followup: Two wreck sites in src/data/uniqueWrecks.js sharing one log-fragment pool: scanning either half marks the other on the chart with a line no map function drew; visiting both assembles the joined log in src/data/codexPages.js — the crew's last three days, ending on a decision the player understands but cannot judge.

units.title: The Sommelier of Coolant
units.followup: barContacts canonical contact at the Refuel Depot bar + purchase option: buying "the Thursday" (small credit price) grants a fuel-efficiency buff for one run and Choir rep +1 — "the censer remembers patronage."

units.title: The Return
units.followup: Story-flag record of near-death fights (survived at hull < 20%) plus a three-sector-day delay, then a numbered selfRegistered encounter spawns the escort keyed to that flag (vignetteInterpreter face/depart motions); the nemesis appears exactly once more, at the next worst moment, and takes a side the player does not expect.

units.title: The Dimming
units.followup: Persistent prop with a decay value in story.flags, measurably dimmer each visit: latch and feed it — a real massline charge interaction — to reset the decay; each donation is logged on the buoy; at three donations the belt quietly names the buoy after the player's hull via news:publish.

units.title: The Two-Yard Feud
units.followup: barContacts rumor rows at station_tethys and station_customs (unlocked once the player has traded at both) resolving into a real one-off pallet job via src/data/missions.js — one disputed pallet, two liens, no manifest; payment is both bars' standing +3, permanently.

units.title: The Complaint Choir
units.followup: barContacts canonical contact group keyed to law receipts: the free review finds one procedural error in any fine the player has paid — always line four — and the first review refunds a fine in real credits; flag clerks_corner, Concord rep +1 ("someone read the form").

units.title: The Question Booth
units.followup: barContacts canonical contact + a real breadcrumb reveal of an uncharted Verge gate POI (gate-coordinate fragment as payment); codex page under Vergé-Layers: "auditors of old doors." The best-question audit is the booth's own ledger and is never explained.

units.title: The Archive's Reading Hour
units.followup: Recurring bar event in the Helios back room during the calendar window: one codex page per attended hour, "Reading Hour, [Week N]" — a 4-6 page authored set in src/data/codexPages.js; attendance is the dock-side option while the window is open.

units.title: The Choir Chair
units.followup: Bar set-dressing + a ropeable pod interaction on the Ashfall tow-line (worldOneOffs rope pattern): reel in the last pod to claim the chair — one free drink per visit, forever, and the whole bar stands up (flag write; stationContacts line).

units.title: The Night Manager
units.followup: barContacts canonical contact at the Cut Claim Outpost, gated to the berth's third watch (worldCalendar stationShiftAt), + tip purchase option; codex page under Fulfillment: "the night manager processes gratitude as inventory"; Fulfillment standing +1 if the player tips.

units.title: The DMC Retirement Watch
units.followup: Dock-side dressing row keyed to the belt mining counter (3+ different fields worked): attending the bell reading at station_ceres grants DMC standing +2; codex page "The Retirement Line."

units.title: The Frontier's Porch Light
units.followup: Beacon interactable keyed to Free-hull loss events: first hull on scene lights the beacon — +3 Free standing and a next-of-kin letter ("The light was on. We knew.") filed as a late mail row in the serial integration pass; per-station porch_lit flags.

units.title: Bracket's Perfect Game
units.followup: Session collision counter inside Bracket's yard radius (character_bracket anchor, src/data/bracket.js) feeds a hail variant on the bracket.js line pattern; flag bracket_zero; the zero becomes one regular line at the Helios bar; Bracket's own bookkeeping marks the perfect game and cites it by day number forever.

units.title: The Runaway Kiln Cools
units.followup: Kiln runtime counter crossing the cool threshold on delivered/jettisoned coolant mass across visits; the state transition persists per save (flag kiln_cooled, Pitborn standing +2); a Pitborn fence later offers a discount memoized "the kiln put in a word."

units.title: The Graveyard Orbit
units.followup: Persistent ring of wrecks (wreckClasses) with an append-at-tail rule keyed to major NPC deaths; scanning a hull's plaque long-form yields one codex page per hull, twenty in all; the newest hull in the ring is always someone the player has heard of.

units.title: The Clinic Ring
units.followup: Understory triage barge (persistent vendor fixture): free repairs cost visible queue TIME with the triage order on display, worse hulls first, your enemies included, which you watch; fire inside the ring once and it is permanent — news:publish broadcast within the day and a faction-wide standing penalty. It is tested once.

units.title: The Regular's Empty Stool
units.followup: Bar set-dressing row at station_ceres gated to the night watch (worldCalendar stationShiftAt) + purchase option: buying the next round for the floor crew grants DMC rep +1; codex page under Shaft 7 (poi_ceres_shaft_seven keeps the stake).

units.title: The Naming
units.followup: Rescue flag + dock ceremony vignette at the Helios yard: a real borrowable assist verb at station_helios (docking speed-up, fairly capped); the mispronounced name is persisted — the yardmaster refuses to correct it, and the tug answers to it.

units.title: The Tally Board
units.followup: Persistent fixture prop bolted to the derelict field's biggest rock (authoredPlaces zone pattern): chalk state in story.flags, one line per deed (stripped, caught the keel, owes the yard), the player's line added on first deed in the field; NPC scavenger ambient barks quote the board's current standings (encounterScripts ambient pool); codex page "The Field Scores."

units.title: The Vael Clause Reader
units.followup: barContacts service contact at station_eunomia gated to a Vael-origin lot in hold at dock: flat-fee read sets flag vael_clause_heard, Vael standing +1 (correct recitation is courtesy), and unlocks a codex page — the Vael contract-language primer.

units.title: The Eris Last Pod
units.followup: Ropeable pod keyed to flag special500.SP2-079 (the chair story live) plus three visits under the line's roll-call bell: a clean cut (massline, low impulse) claims the SP2-079 chair; a hard yank wakes the line — every pod swings once — and the bar goes silent to the player for a sector week (masslineImpactDamage read, bar standing flag).

units.title: The View
units.followup: Dock-side purchase at station_helios (gate: 30+ lifetime docks, story.flags count): fee buys a plaque line on the view-berth board plus one personalized dock greeting; the plaque is read aloud once a year at the Ring Fair bell; berth flag persists. Dock layout is static UI and is not touched (hone A H-17).

units.title: The Requiem For A Tool
units.followup: Bar event at station_forge when a choir:crystalShattered receipt lands on a dock within the day: flag cutter12, DMC and Choir standing +1 each (the collision is the joke), codex page "Cutter 12"; the retired tooth stays on the bar mantel for the rest of the save.

units.title: The Notary
units.followup: Dock comms offer, one per deed type (rescue, kill, delivery, refusal), repeatable per type: accepting stamps the next deed of that type (witnessed flag read at outcome time) and pays its rep once at double weight; the notary's ledger of the player's sealed deeds is a standing codex page — stamped, dull, wonderful.

units.title: The Rival's Round
units.followup: Records a clean player win over Coldburn Rey in the supplied-load relief race, keyed by the canonical raceSettled receipt.

units.title: The Grease Menu
units.followup: barContacts purchase options at any blackmarket bar, gated to heat > 20 at dock: three flat-priced one-shots — registry grease (one scan comes back clean, heat -5 once), a remembered tow (one impound waived), a name spoken quietly (one fence discount) — effects ride the existing law/impound seams; codex page "The Second Column."

units.title: The Bucket Line
units.followup: Seeded crisis week (the hashDaily pass pins a water_crisis_week flag spanning six days): numbered repeatable tow legs up the lane — each leg a short real tow, colony rep via d.rep per leg — and a persistent tally-wall prop (authoredPlaces pattern) that lists the week's haulers forever after the crisis ends.

units.title: The Taxidermist
units.followup: Persistent lair site in the ashfall derelict field (authoredPlaces pattern), unlocked once the player has survived a hunter encounter: trade with the collector at premium trophy prices (deedRecord kill history read); the polished empty slot at the end of the airlock is purchasable — the price is a fight with house rules (numbered encounter script).

units.title: The Librarian's Grudge
units.followup: Persistent fixture at the Tethys archive relay reading record-destruction receipts into story.flags: the causes column accrues against the player's hull number; a dock-side donation option (one click, feeless) moves the player to the donors column of the same ledger, and the librarian's two-line thanks outweigh any fee; codex page "The Grudge Ledger."

units.title: The Cartographer's Corner
units.followup: barContacts lore-read offer at station_veil keyed to 5+ signal:surveyFiled receipts: the purchase renders the player's actual logged route in dry field-guide voice for one screen; Veil standing +2; codex page "Impossible Fixes."

units.title: The Wake Market
units.followup: Persistent buy-back site at a fixed pallas_drift coordinate fed by the cargo:jettisoned event log: everything the player dumps settles into the stall's stock on the slow drift and can be bought back at a markup that is fair (d.charge purchases); inventory persists and updates per save.

units.title: The Flag Change
units.followup: Seeded weekly owner pick at poi_pwreck (per-save seed, week key from worldCalendar): the mast's current fabric flag honestly predicts the encounter there this week — patrol scan, lawful share, or toll — as three numbered-encounter script reuses with visualOverrides fabric props replaced on the seeded rotation; reading the flags is a learnable skill the game never explains.

units.title: The Shelf Drop
units.followup: One-time mining cascade keyed to drill:caveIn in a seeded unstable shelf: the face detaches, house-sized rock pours down the seam, one falling rock flashes payable — latch it mid-fall on your line or dive clear (asteroid layout via src/data/asteroidMotion.js seams; absorbs SP1-148's misfire trigger and fresh ore face; no persistent reshuffle).

units.title: The Resident
units.followup: Dock-like vendor entity at the web's center wreck (placement keys to the SP1-036 Old Web leg): stories-for-supplies trade, maps of every wreck she has watched strip, lichen as a rare good; second act — the scan-count reveal that the hermitage is itself becoming a wreck that trades (absorbs SP2-141).

units.title: The Prize Auction
units.followup: Mine-ring auction site with the captive hauler (mine props per mines.mineCorridorLayout, 325-minefield-wake.js precedent): bid by jettisoning credits into the open escrow (absorbs SP1-143), blow the ring open to free the hauler for faction_mts/scn rep, or ignore; the crew's mayday runs under the patter the whole time and the crew remembers who cleared it.

units.title: The Wreck Court
units.followup: Witness-a-claim verdict at a fresh aftermathWreck with two scavenger crews and a Reach arbiter: judge by who holds a line attached right now (read state.combat.attachments, 1210-the-deadweight pattern, via src/systems/crSituationKit.js); an honest witness earns Reach respect and a finder's fee, vouching against the visible line marks your transponder for SP1-003; SP2-129's sole-juror recess is the court's second, smaller case.

units.title: The Manifest Weigh-In
units.followup: Numbered encounter file src/data/encounters/600-weigh-in.js on script toll (registered in src/data/encounters.js, receipt row in ENCOUNTER_RECEIPTS): the weighmaster names the mass-versus-manifest delta in commodity, never in credits; pay by jettison or in coin; the weighmaster's name is kept on the receipt for later encounters.

units.title: The Anchor Light
units.followup: Silent tug NPC gated on the real hull state (integrity below 25%, heat at zero, more than 800 WU from any station — the receipt fires the check, the gate consumes it): takes an offered line, tows via massline physics to the nearest station ring, casts off unpaid; registry check later reads a crew of zero and a home port that closed years ago; once per save.

units.title: The Sprung Hold
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with pre-latched attachments and a breakable constraint chain (1210-the-deadweight pattern): latch the bent beam with the massline before cutting the frayed strap, or the pallet launches through the field shedding cargo; catch it mid-flight on a line for the whole hold plus the belt's respect, miss and it scatters salvage across a kilometer, first-come.

units.title: Hollow Station's Backlog
units.followup: Claim-office wreck placement on the Hollow Station approach; twenty-two cycles of filings as light debris props; carry either crew's filing or file both and let the stamp's order decide; the winning claim's beacon lights via claimableBodies and the losing crew becomes a recurring rival contact via story.flags.

units.title: The Borrowed Ladder
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter: latch the intact ladder-tether lashed between the two wrecks (state.combat.attachments read, 1210 pattern) and the log cylinder slides down the tether into your hold with its note; a codex fragment now; re-latching on later visits yields nothing but a polite click.

units.title: The Witness
units.followup: Answer scene keyed to a toll lane with priorOutcome escaped, five sector-days later (numbered ambient encounter): honest yes and the kid respects it — the toll quietly caps for you thereafter; a badly-made lie and the kid knows anyway, and likes you more; the answer flag is consumed by toll pricing (gateControlDirector seam).

units.title: The Executor Arrives
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter firing ~40 s after salvage:completed on a seeded family-flagged wreck, uniqueOnce per wreck: hand over the logbook (their story continues — a letter reaches you two sectors later via comms:popup), refuse (the wreck's plaque reads colder when you pass again), or fight them (a real bounty).

units.title: The Keel Bell
units.followup: Keel-release competition hooked to the shipbreak cut seam (src/systems/ceresWorkfleet.js, src/data/ceresShipbreak.js): first line on the falling keel section before the catcher net takes first refusal on the scrap — heavy bonus payout and the yard crew's respect; chalk mark on the tally board cross-ref SP1-040; yard hands' odds move in real time.

units.title: The Two-Line Problem
units.followup: Standoff read from two active attachments on one ore-pod target (src/combat/attachments.js, numbered ambient encounter): cut one line (the loser hates you, the winner pays), catch the pod yourself (nobody pays, everyone respects), or watch physics settle it and collect from both as an independent witness.

units.title: The Clock Trap
units.followup: Ambush-script variant (020-ambush-snare.js) with customs_cutter archetypes and the sensor_tripline signature from src/data/ambushSignatures.js made physical: three cutters box you out of cruise on the marked lane — stand and be fined (a real collectable-at-dock notice item) or bolt and be chased.

units.title: The Insurance Hull
units.followup: Fraud arc, three acts (absorbs SP2-142 serial-plate payout and SP2-158 measured-monument aftermath): let the scuttle happen and bank a real favor stored in state.story.flags, report it (insurance rep, they hate you), or tow them to the refinery mid-act, which nobody has a rule for; refinery reaction via news:publish. Hull damage-state read in a numbered selfRegistered encounter.

units.title: The Triangulation
units.followup: landmarkMissions.js row (scanner-authority precedent in the same file): take any two scan:pulse logs from different positions, the Archive computes the fix, then photograph the fix at the next pulse; the payoff plate shows your own two bearing lines, correct and useless; codex entry plus small bonus; absorbs SP3-165's three-plate lens-drift proof.

units.title: The Successor
units.followup: Tip-choice scene keyed to the save's first-hull record or a two-hour fit snapshot (no new loadout-history ledger; key the copycat to most-used weapon class and escort count from existing deed records): the chosen tip becomes the successor NPC's persistent doctrine flag, their record accrues, and the belt credits the technique to your name via news:publish with a date and a witness. Absorbs SP1-188's maneuver lesson as tip content.

units.title: The Reinstatement
units.followup: Delivery choice gated on state.story.seenComms.pers_voss_suspended (the claim-desk encounter reads the seen-flag before staging): carry the reinstatement to the second crew yourself — Voss rep +4, the second crew's rep +2, codex line "The system ate both. One hull carried the paper." — or refuse and be filed; the refusal reaches the second crew by wire, colder.

units.title: Dorin's Dead Drop
units.followup: Numbered encounter with a two-outcome handoff of the cut seal-log pages: deliver to the Archive (records restored, standing +4) or sell to the hunters' exchange (credits — and within the week one pre-written fine arrives for you, personally, keyed to the outcome flag; the ledger is honest about what it does); seal-log prose as codex overlay "Pre-Written".

units.title: The Hand-Me-Down Route
units.followup: Dock encounter vendor: the sealed route envelope grants berth-priority flags read by docking; one listed berth is seeded a cheat from programSeed — it stings once and becomes your best contact when you catch it; the retiring regular retires to a visitable berth and asks how the route is doing.

units.title: The Insurance Frame
units.followup: landmarkMissions.js row with the seasonal window: scan-pulse the flagged derelict before the seeded scrapper convoy arrives; the plate pays, the convoy's tally comes up one hull short, documented; small bonus plus codex page; the convoy crew hails you once, professionally unamused.

units.title: The 47-B Cold Call
units.followup: Packet item state machine on the spine's post-ending continuation route (end-state gate + one-off mission): one unlisted run, no manifest, one blank page; returning the packet un-filled is the only payout in the game that comes with an apology attached; filling it makes it a blank check on your hull, and Kael's warning was about exactly that.

units.title: The Cold Manifest
units.followup: Six-pod thaw choice, three seeded outcomes (a mechanic, a debtor, a child of somebody important) or deliver all six frozen for the honest price; the woken NPC appears at a dock and remembers the order of the thaw; authored one-off in the SET_PIECE pattern, fallback numbered selfRegistered with three outcome branches.

units.title: The Recruitment Letter
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered job (missions.js data only if clean at build): shadow a Meridian toll run and report its timing — no shots fired, the Reach wants the schedule, not the cargo; 800 cr in unmarked plates, Reach rep +10, Concord heat +8; refusing twice closes the thread with one final line: "Memorable." Sker Vane voice per FIGURES.

units.title: The Wreck Elder's Registry
units.followup: One-off keyed to wreck-visit flags: re-scan the three named wreck sites and read the hull plates aloud on an open channel while Senna listens; every named wreck gains a permanent memorial tag via the uniqueWrecks presentation; DMC rep +5; codex page "The Keeper of Names."

units.title: The Escort Of One
units.followup: Proximity escort check (fly slow and visible beside the convoy, ask for nothing) with the hold-left-full as the real cost; completion pays no credits — a hand-painted child's drawing as an inventory item and Mara standing +6, later converting to a unique hull discount no other faction offers. Mara voice per FIGURES (src/data/narrative.js).

units.title: Fennel Comes Home
units.followup: Micro-fetch bound per the roaming-stories pattern (src/data/roamingStories.js; the leg gates on the lost_goat band/hail surface having been heard): a GOAT (FENNEL) cargo unit with a custom commodityId, ferried back when Bramble's route crosses the sector (event-driven rendezvous); finder fee plus the permanent bar regular line about the third stool.

units.title: Voss's Open Page
units.followup: Single-flight survey run with a live tally rig down the old convoy route (signal:surveyFiled is already a MAIL_EVENT_NAMES event in src/data/mail.js; the staging leg gates on state.story.seenComms.pers_voss_suspended): the scale confirms the hole — one-line ledger correction, DMC rep +5, the clerk keeps the page open — or reads one extra hull, which becomes the codex page "The Forty-First."

units.title: The Paid Fare
units.followup: Authored search chain (recon_scan stages over seeded debris, SET_PIECE pattern, fallback numbered chain): scan candidate debris for pod transponders; seeded ending found-alive (a passenger with one scene's worth of story, via crew data) or found-at-peace (the life-support log is the reward).

units.title: The Warm Tow
units.followup: tow_recovery-type mission row in MISSION_TYPES: pod latched and running warm, pod temperature as a deadlineS proxy for cold hours, the threat entirely physical — debris, tolls, your own line discipline; arrival pays and the patient's family names a berth after your hull.

units.title: The Mole's Handoff
units.followup: Numbered file script 'whisper' with a scan tell (DIST_TELL_R pattern, src/systems/encounterScripts.js): scan during the forty-second drift reads the hold-vs-mass mismatch; then choose — report it (Concord rep, flag mole_reported pulls the cutter from the customs rotation) or sell the observation to the ghost (a stolen scan schedule: story flag the patrol planner reads to keep patrols off the player for one day).

units.title: The First-Rights Picket
units.followup: Claim-contest variant of the numbered-file claimThreat script (src/systems/encounterScripts.js; src/data/encounters/050-claim-threat.js is the family base): cross the picket and the crew fights (worse armed than it acts); hold off 60 s and the lead pays a third of the salvage pool as a finds-fee; leave and return the next day to find the wreck cleanly stripped (per-wreck flag).

units.title: The Drafter
units.followup: Ambient numbered encounter with a speed/position check (matched velocity 30 WU astern for 20 s, src/systems/encounterScripts.js): accept the toll trade — d.grant/d.charge credit transfer, the drafter added to the band as a named acquaintance — or refuse and she peels off with dignity intact (bark, no grudge).

units.title: The Reefer Handoff
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter spawning a fragile venting prop pod on a one-watch timer (fragileCargo patterns, src/systems/fragileCargo.js): deliver to the Forge refinery for the container's whole margin and a recurring named hauler; fail and the venting writes a harmless but humiliating ice cloud (cosmetic one-shot keyed to the memory receipt).

units.title: The Seam Singer
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with an audio-cue prop (the tone echoes differently off ore than rock; audio leg keys on the same memory receipt): follow the song's echo to a rich co-mining site — she cracks, you haul, honest split via mining yield events; her song later buyable as a rig tune (permanent small survey buff, src/data/modules.js module or trait).

units.title: The Maroon
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with a tetherable pod prop the player tows (tetherable: true, beacon-tow precedent; barks table in the file, src/systems/encounterScripts.js): ferry him for a future-ambush forewarning flag plus bar gossip, leave him, or hand him to a passing pack (Reach rep intent).

units.title: The Air Auction
units.followup: Numbered file script 'distress' variant with a second responder squad spawned by the same runtime (src/data/encounters/100-distress-call.js family): outbid, outrun, or outfight the Reach collector; rescue without payment for faction-wide gratitude plus a named family that writes later, or let the Reach have it and hear about it in bars for years (deedRecord tag).

units.title: The Courtesy
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter keyed to a no-fire counter in state.story.flags (three hostile encounters left without firing; cache prop via beacons, quiet_ghost archetype passive behavior): the ghost drops a cache sized honestly from the distance to the next station; the courtesy repeats once more at a count of ten, then never again — restraint has a budget too.

units.title: The Heir
units.followup: NamedHunter file variant chained on the defeat receipt, arriving 2-5 sector-days after the kill (src/systems/encounterScripts.js namedHunter script; heir entry added to the NAMED_CAPTAINS roster pattern in src/data/encounters.js): better escorts, worse experience; defeat closes the file — future pack encounters open with respect (visible bark change via priorOutcome) — and letting the heir escape keeps it open for one better return.

units.title: The Professional
units.followup: NamedHunter variant keyed to a per-captain escape counter in state.encounterDirector.named (NAMED_CAPTAINS state precedent; src/data/encounters/060-named-hunter.js): the third escape from the SAME captain triggers the mid-pursuit choice UI — split voids the writ, pays both, and the hunter becomes a bar story that follows you; refuse and win the fourth round and the hull genuinely retires either way (that is the code).

units.title: The Honor Guard
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with per-zone ROE (setEntityDoctrine per-entity, src/ai/doctrine.js; src/data/encounters/1207-the-witnessed-price.js is the doctrine-scene precedent): salvage the allowed sections freely (the drones mark your respect in their log), touch a crew area and they escalate precisely, not lethally — they take the module back.

units.title: The Grid Hostage
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with a towable core prop and colony lighting state in story.flags (endingWorldPresence precedent, src/systems/endingWorldPresence.js): negotiate, sneak the core back on a line, or pay — every resolution leaves the colony's lights at a state you chose, visible from orbit, for the rest of the save; shoot the core and the map section browns out for weeks.

units.title: The Debt Finds You
units.followup: Numbered file with gates.requiresCompletedShape + blockAfterOutcome reading story.depthProgramEncounters (priorOutcome in src/systems/crSituationKit.js): fires the next sector day after a toll/whisper shape resolved 'escaped' — a lean interceptor shadows a full minute, then hails; settle the original toll plus interest (credit intent, flag cleared) or fight a motivated, stat-boosted collector.

units.title: The Sheepdog
units.followup: Ambush-file variant keyed off state.story.flags['sheepdog_paid'] (src/systems/encounterScripts.js; src/data/encounters/020-ambush-snare.js reuse; same-day-ambush precondition in the file's gates): the sheepdog genuinely intervenes in future ambushes in that sector — capped at two interventions per sector day for a flat fee, because a subscription that always works is a tax, not a character; refuse and both packs hunt you next pass.

units.title: The Witnessed Standoff
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with two convoy columns stopped nose to nose (src/data/encounters/1207-the-witnessed-price.js precedent for witnessed-scene construction): be the witness — the truth posts to the news wire and both sides pay a fee — or nudge one hull a meter and let physics end the argument; one side wins, the other remembers (faction memory tag via deedRecord).

units.title: The Wrecker's Bout
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with weapons-locked ROE (doctrine, src/ai/doctrine.js) and massline tug-of-war as the weapon; audience hulls hold the ring boundary (vignette ring motion, src/systems/vignetteInterpreter.js): gated in-file on a post-duel-loss visit (SP1-109 The Ring Rules receipt); the crowd pays for spectacle, and a good showing — win or lose — makes you ring-regular (the champion nods, forever after).

units.title: The Unclaimed Reward
units.followup: Claim watcher in the bounty-board seam (src/systems/missionBoardOps.js): 3+ in-game days after a tagged-kill bounty completes unclaimed, the board pays out minus a 2% handling fee itemized as "motion" and sets flag desk_moved; future claims at that board pre-waive the fee with the memo "you learned."

units.title: The Resignation Letter
units.followup: Drop attached to the boss-outcome facts (crSituationKit facts; numbered delivery encounter, src/systems/encounterScripts.js): deliver it to the pack in Pallas Drift for a succession with less blood than expected — the sector's raid prices actually soften (economy intent) — or keep it; the pack hardens, and the letter is the best item description in your hold.

units.title: The Meridian Gift With A Clause
units.followup: Economy contract via src/data/economyContractTemplates.js plus one seeded recall day; gates Meridian standing >= 30 and lifetime profit > 20k: credits compound at real daily interest until the collector visits once — survivable by flying (outrun or outmaneuver, never a raw credit snatch); surviving the recall gracefully doubles the relationship permanently.

units.title: The Extra Crate
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with cargo inspection and three seeded outcome props (module from src/data/modules.js, a stowaway, or a very lost pet drone): open it, deliver it somewhere, or teach her the broker's trick — bill it as sentimental freight and dock it anyway (flag; the customs scan reads the paperwork honestly ever after).

units.title: The Archive Librarian's Fine
units.followup: One-off mission via src/systems/missions.js chained to the library_tapes roaming story; gates on 30+ codex pages read: the borrower's estate is a wreck in the player's charted sectors (uniqueWrecks rumor-to-bearing-to-scan pattern, src/systems/uniqueWrecks.js); recovery yields Archive standing +4 and the codex page 'The Borrower's Estate' — the fine assessed at one credit and a formal apology the desk stamps.

units.title: The Route Auction
units.followup: One-off decoy-lane mission against ambush-signature data (src/data/ambushSignatures.js); gates on high heat at a night-shift dock at the Den: success destroys the history (flag routes_cleaned — one-time scan immunity against one bounty hunt); refusing means the history sells and the sector's ambush rate rises for a week of game time.

units.title: Quill's Second Copy
units.followup: Quill read-ring logic + copy-stamp check (src/data/quill.js): fires when a delivered wreck's manifest has already been copied once; AR-3 refuses on principle, copies anyway, files the third as "RUMOR: THAT LOG. CONFIDENCE: TOTAL" — flag quill_rumor, codex page "The Rumor Index", Archive standing +2 (they side with the index).

units.title: The Comet Run
units.followup: Race-type mission with courseSector and moving gate positions (race in MISSION_TYPES, src/data/missions.js): runs inside SP3-005's perihelion window with gates drifting on the comet's actual ephemeris; purse in the hundreds across three pay bands; winners' hull names chalked on the comet-post until next perihelion.

units.title: The Alibi Engine
units.followup: One-off mission via src/data/missions.js plus the warrant/heat seam; gates on Concord heat above threshold at first dock at the march: the haul is dull and perfectly timed; completion clears one active warrant's evidence trail (flag alibi_confirmed); payment small, value structural.

units.title: The Pitborn Adoption Rite
units.followup: Fence-sale counter keyed to deniable:fenceThanked receipts (deedRecord listens there, src/systems/deedRecord.js; five sells to Pitborn fences): the cull-side ceremony grants a welded plate with your callsign scratched by every yardmaster in turn — permanent shipScreen dressing, Pitborn prices +5% on your sells forever, flag yard_family.

units.title: The Understory's Seed Debt
units.followup: Garden runtime state check plus one-off visit mission (src/systems/faction_understory.js; fires when a hull dies in a sector with an Understory garden at stage 2): the unarmed spore-tender intercepts and asks custody of the wreck — visit the garden (proximity + scan) with the tender watching and the garden stages up one level as thanks; Understory standing +4, flag seed_debt_paid.

units.title: The Dead Man's Manifest
units.followup: Four-site scavenge chain via the salvage_signal script + follow-on stubs (followOnStub pattern, src/systems/encounterScripts.js; src/data/encounters/110-salvage-signal.js family): seeded outcomes — one pod crushed, one already claimed, one full, one full of something else entirely; total payout caps under ~1.5x a comparable delivery contract — the find is the payoff.

units.title: The Transponder That Isn't Yours
units.followup: Authored three-leg chain in the SET_PIECE_MISSIONS pattern (three commonStages, no branch): the station records office, the old hijacker's actual wreck via uniqueWrecks rumor-to-bearing-to-scan (src/systems/uniqueWrecks.js), and a notarized scan — ends with the record corrected and a codex page on registry reform nobody asked for.

units.title: The Amnesty Burn
units.followup: Amnesty event on the hunter spawn table (src/data/bountyHunters.js), window expressed in world time per src/data/worldCalendar.js (this entry anchors the second-watch open), gated on bounty > 0 at posting: reach the Helios law desk inside the window — bounty cleared at a discount, hunters paid off (d.rep intents), and one hunter who followed you the whole way respects you afterward (named-hunter state).

units.title: Ruckus Closes The Work Order
units.followup: Ruckus runtime counter + line variant at poi_ruckus_work_yard (work-order completions counted at the yard runtime; free-repair flag consumed by service pricing): after 3+ completed work orders the board sets flag ruckus_idle and adopts the player's hull as its standing work order — every future dock generates one small free repair; DMC standing +3.

units.title: The Claim Tag Wedding
units.followup: Claim-system dialogue keyed to claim:claimed with a rival crew physically present and contesting (src/systems/claims.js; body registry in src/data/claimableBodies.js): sign or decline — signing grants the joint-yield flag for that body (both yields doubled permanently) and one recurring co-owner letter ("The claim is well. The scale is honest. — V"); declining earns respect and no grudge.

units.title: The Second Last Argument
units.followup: Numbered file gated requiresCompletedShape on 901-last-argument (src/data/encounters/901-last-argument.js, src/systems/lastArgument.js): the same gambit replays with a station fuel line as the mark; three-way outcome — end it quiet, end it loud, back the blackmailer for a currency of favors — via crSituationKit settleSituation.

units.title: The Runner at the Ring
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered file at the Tally: the pursuit is real AI — vignetteInterpreter chase motion for the runner, Concord cutters on patrol doctrine (src/ai/doctrine.js); block him with your hull (Concord rep, contraband reward), wave him through (Quiet thanks, flag), or hold position and watch.

units.title: The Vulture Ring
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with the vulture orbit (vignetteInterpreter MOTIONS 'vulture') and persistent outcome flags: join the ring and share, kill the ship early and own the wreck while the belt remembers, or defend the dying ship — a stranger's life for rep everywhere.

units.title: The Slag Diver
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with a fixed seeded waypoint line and hazard window (uniqueWrecks timingGate precedent, src/data/uniqueWrecks.js): fly her line into the Roaming Burn's vent window for the second cache — she keeps the first and toasts you at the bar — or fail, and she tows YOUR hull out and adds the debt to the same ledger.

units.title: The Prop Wreck
units.followup: Numbered file script 'distress' with custom scan_tell lines (ENCOUNTER_BARKS distress block precedent, src/data/encounters.js): spot the tell before the spring and leave clean with sellable proof, or spring it — a close-quarters fight where the wreck itself is cover for both sides.

units.title: The Broodyard
units.followup: Capital-boss-adjacent numbered encounter on the subsystem pattern (src/systems/capitalBossEncounters.js) with rack targets: each rack pops like a pinata and the swarm thins by arithmetic; the emptied hull surrenders by powering down and pays an intact spawn-rack module nobody else has.

units.title: The Efficiency Audit
units.followup: Numbered ambient encounter reading fitted modules (src/core/fittedModules.js) against usage stats: accept and get a real refit recommendation that is actually good, or decline politely and stay marked AWAITING OPTIMIZATION — it checks back, forever, kindly.

units.title: The Genuine Article
units.followup: Numbered file script 'distress' with counter-gated tell lines — fires only after the persistent bait counter in story.flags passes two escaped bait distresses in-sector: a second scan pulse, deliberately, finds the real heartbeat under the fake signature; the rescue pays double reputation because you risked it on a read.

units.title: The Counter-Contract
units.followup: Numbered file script 'bountyHunter' variant (src/data/encounters/040-bounty-hunter.js) spawning a second hunter squad keyed to live bounty state (src/systems/bountyHunt.js): a three-way fight where any pair can ally for the moment, deliver the writ-holder's wreck to the rival for double, or watch two professionals duel and sell the story later.

units.title: Plunge Runners
units.followup: Zone presence row (src/data/sectorZones.js, P.raiders-style) with a custom route plus the existing reentry heat model (src/data/planets.js) — the divers fly the player's own physics on the second watch of market days: follow and survive to reach the band's-edge vendor for a discounted heat-treated commodity and a codex entry.

units.title: The Jumped Seam
units.followup: Numbered file on script 'claimThreat' (src/data/encounters/050-claim-threat.js) with a beacon-as-prop and attachments tug-of-war logic, claims read via state.claims (gates.claimsOnly — the player owns the in-sector claim): physically pull the beacon, pay them off, or let it ride into a claim-defense war.

units.title: The Interest
units.followup: Refusal records in story.flags plus a matured-deal numbered encounter, uniqueOnce per bargain: the same deal with better terms and real safety included, from a counterpart who has earned the yes; refuse a second time and they accept it gracefully, once, as a person would (exit flag).

units.title: The Tailings Fire
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with a burning prop on a real drift vector and a massline-physics rescue: tow or shove the pile clear before it cooks the three-habitat camp; the camp's gratitude is a permanent dock discount and the best fuel in the belt.

units.title: The Ring Rules
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with a pd_screen boundary prop (331-pd-screen-wall.js tech) and a single-spawn rule, purse via d.grant: an honest 1v1 with a real purse — win inside the ring and even their pack respects it (a chalk on the tally); win by cheating and every pack in the sector treats it as a debt.

units.title: The Bond Audit
units.followup: Clamp hold check plus lawful-state read (zero flags, zero contraband, zero debt) and one inventory item: presenting the triplicate apology at any desk waives one future clerical delay; flag clamped_the_clamp.

units.title: The Relay Chain
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter gated on the prior rescue outcome (crSituationKit priorOutcome 'rescued'; roster memory via state.story.flags): the second rescue earns a permanent employer dock discount, and the radio traffic between rescues starts treating you as their personal roadside service.

units.title: The Corner
units.followup: Authored mission on the economyContracts seams (src/systems/economyContracts.js) reading the economyCycles schedule: buy first and the three pay you to step aside, escort all three and be owed by a syndicate, or beat them to the refinery and sell into the spike yourself.

units.title: The Stowaway Cache
units.followup: Loss-ledger read (contactDeedMemory / impound records) plus a one-shot hold event, gated in the leg on an undocked streak of five days: the lost item returns from the real loss record; flag latchchild_rent; Latch-Child's wreck-tidying in your sectors improves one grade.

units.title: The Read Fee
units.followup: Per-wreck read service keyed to wreck-scan events (repeatable per wreck), fee via d.charge, fragments via src/data/codexPages.js: honest-method lore ("the galley's coffee pot was still warm; impact came from above"), a codex page per read, and the Archive's debt of gratitude after ten.

units.title: The Wreck Deed
units.followup: Authored chain — auction leg plus a claim-defense leg reusing the claim_threat script; hull reward via a disabled entity grant (1210-the-deadweight pattern): win the auction, defend or settle the claim physically, deliver the deed intact, and the capital-adjacent hull is yours to strip or register.

units.title: The Smuggler's Confession Booth
units.followup: Room offer via src/ui/station/barContacts.js (fires on the first dock after three-plus stolen lots sold) plus the heat seam and one delayed band line keyed to a day window: take the minute for flag weight_off and a one-time heat -3 — the room heard it; the room settled it.

units.title: The One Favor
units.followup: Authored mission via the missions.js authored pattern (fallback numbered selfRegistered job chain), rep gate on faction_free — fires when Frontier rep crosses zero from either side: a genuinely hard job whose briefing names every risk correctly; refusing is honored forever; accepting makes the Frontier yours and you theirs.

units.title: The Null Auction
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter with jettisoned-credit bids capped at pocket change and a news rewrite via news:publish with sourceRef override (history pool from deedRecord): the winning bid buys one seeded event's next wire mention reframed as a retraction-with-footnote — the original line stays legible somewhere, because this world keeps receipts.

units.title: The Belt Strike
units.followup: Numbered encounter pair reading a shared story flag, consequences via faction rep intents (d.rep) and economy notes: haul for the company (pay, miner resentment) or run supply through the picket for the union (rep, company resentment); either way prices and patrols visibly shift for days.

units.title: The Hyperion Cell Debt
units.followup: Purchase counter (fuel-cell buys at station_hyperion_claim, three visits running) plus a pricing flag and one inventory item — the roster, every regular's name on it: permanent crew pricing on fuel cells at that station (-15%); flag crew_priced.

units.title: The Reactor Ferry
units.followup: Authored tow mission posted on a seeded reactor-casualty event, with a sim-time fuse (deadlineS plus a visible countdown) and a real explosion on failure via lootShards — visible from the colony and remembered by it; success pays from three directions: crew, company, colony.

units.title: The Deadweight Derby
units.followup: Race mission posted at the yard on off-shifts (repeatable) with a mandatory latched tow prop on the course, hulk props from src/data/wreckClasses.js: prizes scale with hulk intactness at the line, and the yard re-sells your "raced" hulk with a plaque.

units.title: The Credible Loss
units.followup: Race mission with inverted scoring bands (rewards on the near-miss) and a fixed-line autopilot rival (combatDoctrine): throw it cleanly — harder than winning — for triple pay, or win honestly and he doubles your fee out of respect for the insult.

units.title: The Perishable Sprint
units.followup: Delivery contract with a real decay on the commodity state (economyContracts + economyCycles; fallback numbered encounter with deadlineS): triple rate inside the window, the colony's market stock visibly recovers, latecomers sell at normal rate to a grateful-but-broke dome.

units.title: The Wrong Way
units.followup: Race mission (repeatable through the season) whose run produces a real, sellable map of the stream's slow lanes — a persisted record the navigation leg reads via the map seam (src/ui/map/), salvor purse via d.grant: the map makes the upstream route permanently faster for everyone.

units.title: The Misdeclared Freight
units.followup: Scan context plus a delivery mission to poi_helios_pit_line and a codex overlay ("For —"): deliver it as-is and the crew fund's beneficiary is found — a retired scale clerk — completing a nineteen-year-old order; Tycho standing +5.

units.title: The Band Survey
units.followup: src/data/landmarkMissions.js row family offered at station_customs, with beacon props (place_lane_beacon precedent) and band predicates from src/data/planets.js PLANET_SITE bands (reentry/danger/skim/sling): drop one buoy at each Anvil band edge; the four rings pulse once, together — planetary band map codex entry plus a small bonus.

units.title: The Impound Grudge Interview
units.followup: Grudge-gated shelf dressing keyed to impoundGrudge state (src/systems/impoundGrudge.js): the labeled slot is a prop at the Reach impound shelf near station_sker, one size too generous; settling the underlying fine moves your callsign to the shorter, prouder CLEARED column (flag slot_cleared).

units.title: The Debt Collector's Duet
units.followup: Debt-state read + witness window on the creditor-hull hail (economy debt seam): one assist, scan or dock inside three minutes of the hail is the story — the debt clears on witness alone, once (flag story_current), and the creditor greets you as "the story" thereafter.

units.title: The Fire Watch
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter near station_helios with a burning module prop: shove it off the spine via the massline/bolus force seams (src/data/bolusForces.js) — save it for rep and a dock discount, or let it torch and the station rebuilds and mentions it; seeded once per sector week (hashDaily 1-in-5).

units.title: The Verge Pilgrims
units.followup: Lane-contact convoy on the festival gate (choir pilgrim runtime precedent) crossing from the Veil gate to the far marker, with the lamp floor and the one-minute all-dark of SP3-103/106; escorting the full crossing is its own receipt; codex entry.

units.title: The Crusher Trail
units.followup: NPC hauler job (npcJobs, saveVersion v12) with a massline-attached boulder spawned on each station shift change (stationShiftAt), inbound on the refinery approach; taut-line presentation via MONOFILAMENT_BLADE_TAUT_RATIO (src/render/vfx.js); cutting the line is massline:playerLineCut and the band reacts.

units.title: The Long Follow
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter: spawn the racer hull on the trade lane and judge 120 s of visual contact honestly (vignetteInterpreter near/trail awaits); keep up and they introduce themselves at the next bar as a named contact tipping credits-worthy rumors (barContact flag); lose them and it never happened.

units.title: The Wolf Pack
units.followup: Scavenger wings arrive in file 60 s after a capital-class kill, inside 500 WU: scavenger presence template with job-signature lights via emitNpcJobSignature (src/render/vfx.js), donor plates from wreckAftermathDressing.js; green go-lamps over chosen plates, red over contested; contesting the claim runs the salvage dispute path.

units.title: The Rodeo
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter gated to a claimed seam while you work it (cooldown one day): attachment tug-of-war on the massline — re-lasso your own rocks, shoot their lines, or out-score them by throwing bigger; scoring on massline throw events (tow_recovery precedent); they concede the seam with a tip of the hat.

units.title: The Ticketed Wreck
units.followup: Numbered ambient encounter at the Wreck Cathedral during a seeded tour window (cooldown one day): tour column (vignetteInterpreter) with the narrator's one honest sentence the script does not advertise (codex page on completion), or chase the poacher off the far side for the operator's fee (d.grant).

units.title: Toll War
units.followup: Two numbered files on the toll script sharing state.story.flags['toll_war_sector'] (src/systems/encounterScripts.js toll handler; planner collision made deliberate, minSectorTier 2): pay one side and slip through the brawl, or escort either pack for a day for a cut of the other's toll; the lane stays contested for days.

units.title: The Honest Fence
units.followup: Bounty gate (cooldown 1 h per consensus) on a numbered selfRegistered file: she re-registers stolen goods into clean paperwork — sell hot cargo at 70% value with zero rep damage (commodityMoralTags read, src/data/commodityMoralTags.js; d.grant/charge intents); her receipt is a stamped chit other hulls can scan later.

units.title: The Phantom Patrol
units.followup: Patrol presence template on a hash-picked watch each week with a lamps-off state until hailed (lamp-bus gain gate keyed to the hail receipt): three law hulls light up exactly where the radar blips were and conduct a perfectly routine inspection; codex entry on the law's oldest trick.

units.title: The Skimmer Shift
units.followup: Civilian zone presence + harvest-barge jobs (npcJobs, saveVersion v12) staged to the skim corridor's first watch: running lights and heat-scoop glow along the weigh line, corridor-etiquette hail, a comms nod for polite flying, and the last barge's flood flash (annoyance, not law) if you cut the line.

units.title: The Survivor's Lamp
units.followup: Crew-pod payload entity spawned on kills with a 4-minute life window: the manually strobed "here" pattern, latch via massline turns the strobe steady, tow to any berth pays a small bonus and a rep nod and hangs the pod's lamp in the station's bunting for a day; miss the window and the last blink is the only record.

units.title: The Hitchhiker
units.followup: Pickup entity with contactHail comms line + massline carry + strobe lamp channel, hash-picked once per week near the merc lane: a small fee and a drop-off at any berth (codex entry); two suits exist per seed and the second is the anomaly payoff — it knocks, and nobody has ever been inside.

units.title: The Census
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter at the border checkpoint (station_customs) with physical-response steps: jettison one unit and name it, flash lights twice, name the last hull you refused; the row persists in story.flags and a census follow-up encounter opens years later quoting it back word for word (gates.requiresCompletedShape).

units.title: The Pulse Seam
units.followup: Hazard-window mining contract (uniqueWrecks timingGate precedent, src/data/uniqueWrecks.js) posted at the Veil station after one survived pulse inside the radiation field: hold-and-dash loops on the public pulse clock, payout scaled by purity, module discount as priced gratitude (economyTerms).

units.title: The Last Shift Witness
units.followup: Bell-window reading interaction at world_site_ceres_second_measure keyed to the filed Last Shift evidence (lastShift:archived receipt; doss_ceres_last_shift evidence read): flag last_shift_read_aloud, the yard's night light becomes permanent dressing, DMC standing +6, codex page "Said Right."

units.title: The Courier's Ghost Run
units.followup: Keyed to courier contracts completed in-sector (deed counter; no lane-history ledger exists): the dispatcher appends the memory run to a later courier contract — fly it with honest deviation inside tolerance for a memory bonus; flag lane_from_memory unlocks their best contracts permanently.

units.title: Ride the Front
units.followup: landmarkMissions.js row (src/data/landmarkMissions.js) with a surge-phase occupancy predicate (pure seasonalWeatherPhase read), offered at station_io_merc during solar_wind weeks: sixty seconds inside the visible front, small bonus + codex entry (storm rider).

units.title: The Bell Ringer's Apprentice
units.followup: Keeper-contact offer chained on the witnessed unscheduled toll (choir:bellHeadRing receipt): three-rest-one toll interaction, each correct toll lights one foundry window row via the lamp-bus gain path and completed rows stay lit for the season, wrong order rings flat (existing toll audio recipe); codex entry.

units.title: The Gate Sprint
units.followup: Race-type mission posted during scheduled traffic lulls (weekly lulls in the glue): a clean timed sprint on the station-to-gate lane geometry; beat the record and your time is the record (persisted in story.flags, visible at both stations); traffic control's "recreational velocity" advisories via news:publish.

units.title: Shoot the Crown
units.followup: landmarkMissions.js row (same shape as CAVED_SHAFT_PROBE, src/data/landmarkMissions.js) with the aurora season forecast (SP3-021) as its availability predicate, offered on the ordinary mission board at station_tethys: scan pulse under the burning limb; photography moment + codex entry + small bonus.

units.title: Separate the Dancers
units.followup: landmarkMissions.js row + ordinary massline physics on the two asteroidMotion bodies, offered at station_drift after the player witnesses one full binary period: latch one boulder, burn against the orbit, pull them apart; the abraded dust ring persists via gas volume; the binary becomes two solitary rocks with a named history (codex entry).

units.title: The Futures Broker
units.followup: Numbered encounter + economy intents via economyCycles reading the scheduled convoy (spawns via the convoy script, src/systems/encounterScripts.js): escort it (honest win), raid it (profit, wanted), or ignore it and the market moves without you — all three visible in next-day prices.

units.title: The Impound Auction
units.followup: Wreck/tow mission in the WRECK_MISSIONS pattern (src/data/wreckMissions.js, tow_recovery type) gated on ≥1 impounded hull record (uniqueOnce per hull): the hull spawns disabled at the Forge Outlying Yard, three claimant-hulls race you to her, and the yard ledger entry persists where other NPCs reference it.

units.title: Fire the Furnace
units.followup: sectorWonders build (operations/payloads/receivers, src/data/sectorWonders.js) + a registered place record for the cold foundry near station_ashcache: tow the ignition slug from the redoubt (ordinary massline work), seat it, and the relight is a sustained event light that floods the ash fields orange and stays as a sector feature; codex entry.

units.title: The Lane Priority Bond
units.followup: Numbered encounter posted by a Concord desk hull after three completed deliveries (count in glue; missions.js/dock-contract path only if clean at build time, per hones): the bond buys a sector-day scan waiver at the rings, the skipped queue is visibly resentful, and refusing all bonds makes one particular customs officer remember your face (flavor barks).

units.title: The Sworn Scan
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter (fallback from the DIRTY missions.js SET_PIECE_MISSIONS pattern) after the fifth clean patrol scan in-sector: ride with a convoy and read three hulls (recon_scan stage); real contraband pays a bonus and a Concord contact, nothing found still pays — he suspected as much.

units.title: Chain of Custody
units.followup: Numbered encounter with a custody-pod fragile prop (not the dirty missions files, per hones) after a witnessed convoy raid: carry the sealed black box to Coalition HQ for Concord rep, with Reach and Quiet approaches at the refuel stop; the trial's outcome hits the news wire a week later via publishSituationNews (src/systems/crSituationKit.js); every fork is remembered.

units.title: The Bar Bet That Is Real
units.followup: barContacts twice-in-a-sitting rail counter at station_beltout opens the bet: fly the approach rock loaded to exactly the hold's stated max, engines cold, once — approach-corridor geometry check; success pays both crews' pooled stake (they were betting on your side, they explain), failure costs one line — "Well. Now we know." The regulars retell it with your actual numbers.

units.title: The Anchor Drag
units.followup: Numbered selfRegistered encounter reading attachment tension telemetry (src/combat/attachments.js) when a scheduled freight column passes (uniqueOnce per column): latch and hold with no winching and no slack against a posted record kept in story.flags; the record-holder's identity is a legend you can meet.

units.title: The Kepler Unbroken Offer
units.followup: One-off mission gated on scanning the dead-corvette ring (poi_kepler_hulk stands in for the unregistered Unbroken mast, per entries-comms-b precedent) then docking at station_kepler_scar: a ten-minute listen with the exchange-issue decoder rig, the rig becomes a permanent inventory item that pings mast-like structures sector-wide, codex page "Still Winning."

units.title: Front Riders
units.followup: green-mark salvage bonus seam (the marks are findable debris rows) + codex entry for riding a full surge

units.title: The Toll Echo
units.followup: three delayed positioned audio:cue copies keyed to the toll event; the chord spot is real geometry (player pos vs clusters)

units.title: The Folding Star
units.followup: proximity-keyed split on the background star row (sectorVisualProfiles vocabulary); codex anomaly page

units.title: The Marooned Trawler
units.followup: zone presence single-spawn + tow-to-lee on the existing massline physics; thank-you flare via explosionIgnition cue; good-samaritan receipt

units.title: The Searchlight Argument
units.followup: two NPC headlight slots + patrol-route pair; the accusatory second is choreography data

units.title: The Measured Ring
units.followup: opticScatterSpecsFor-style seeded placement on a circle constraint + claim-mark donor prop; Archive scan bonus + codex anomaly page

units.title: The Quiet Zone
units.followup: gas-volume velocity-freeze radius (per-volume stillness scalar on the _gas layer); seeded position row + codex anomaly page

units.title: The Tumbleweed
units.followup: persistent wandering prop on a fixed ballistic path (asteroidMotion); one small unfound cache; band commentary rows

units.title: The Wash Refusal
units.followup: dock vignette keyed to hull story-mark flags: the washer re-tries the spot on every later visit without comment

units.title: Tally Eve's List
units.followup: provenance fines ledger read: the player's own hull and fine join the read-back when one exists (saveVersion v14 ledger)

units.title: The Burn Line
units.followup: race mission with hazard-window gates (timingGate pattern from src/data/uniqueWrecks.js); band records persist in story.flags; escalating entry fee

units.title: The Hare
units.followup: purse-window spawn leg: three-bearing hunters on a timed window; clearing your name mid-chase closes it; every hunter remembers by name

units.title: The Pace Car
units.followup: wake-following speed/safety bonus through the fog stretch + tip-her hand-signal for the deep shortcut she has never told anyone

units.title: Meteor Hiss
units.followup: audio:cue with doppler rate on the weatherMeteors slot entities; cue rate-limited by the discoverySound throttle idiom

units.title: The Open Vault
units.followup: cargo drop path + strobe lamp finishes on pod donors; the pallets are the loot

units.title: The Ashfall Calendar
units.followup: ringed prop (donor rock + band emissive tints); the count reads the seasonal ledger (weatherSeasonAt history)

units.title: The Quiet Watch
units.followup: watch-keyed MUSIC_STEMS gain row (src/data/audioRecipes.js) so the pad and the thin-out are the mix performing the night watch

units.title: The Broken Clock
units.followup: station-scoped +47 s offset on the existing stationOffsetS hash path (src/data/worldCalendar.js) + the clock prop

units.title: The Hot Potato
units.followup: numbered selfRegistered encounter with a passed prop pod: catch the crate mid-relay (contraband prize), warn the pursued (Quiet rep), or shadow the relay to its drop cache (beacons seam)

units.title: The Calendar Rock
units.followup: worldOneOffs row; the notch count reads calendarDay(simTime) so it is exactly right on every visit

units.title: The Ledger's Second Line
units.followup: the ledger read/write logic (rescue/tow follow-up batch) gets a second-line row per return visit

units.title: The Painted Asteroid
units.followup: donor prop + survey-drone misclassification gag row in the discovery log

units.title: The Scarecrow Buoy
units.followup: buoy prop with the suit dressing; compliance stat cited in the weigh-station ledger page

units.title: The Burn Lamp
units.followup: lamp prop + offering dressing; the ticket is a fixture line on the redoubt maintenance board

units.title: The Last Lantern
units.followup: lantern prop at the light-line terminus + the UNLIT file row in the sector ledger

units.title: The Metronome
units.followup: once-per-day tick cue keyed to the stone (calendarDay boundary); toll-crew superstition band rows

units.title: The Prayer Rock
units.followup: coin-weld counter flag per save + the rock as a chartable place record

units.title: The Borrowed Beacon
units.followup: beacon ident row keyed to the misfiled name; chart margin note in the sector ledger

units.followup: layered-paint prop tint stack; registry-page contradiction row
